services.name: Pontoon Rentals
services.desc: Premium tri-toon rentals, fuel included, easy reservations, and unforgettable days on the water. We have six pontoon boats available for rent, accommodating groups up to 14 passengers. We have three boats at the Caribbean Marina location and three boats at the Sunset Boat Yards location. We require that the driver be 25 years of age with significant boating experience. In other words, driving a boat “a couple of times” doesn’t really count because, most likely, it was not on a lake this large or busy and many people are not accustomed to driving a boat with ten to twelve passengers. Anyone with a DUI or BUI cannot drive our boats. Driver must be responsible and have significant boating

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: When buying a boat, the biggest unknowns can be the most intimidating. Is the engine in good working condition? Has the boat been properly maintained? Are there any major cosmetic or mechanical issues? At Bay to Bay Boat Club, we understand those concerns. We have a long-standing reputation to uphold, and we take great pride in the condition and maintenance of every boat we sell. Our boats are thoroughly inspected before they are offered for sale. We go through each boat from bow to stern, checking the mechanical systems, electrical components, and overall condition.
